newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK ECONMIN TO SPEAK ON ECONOMY IN NEW YORK.
newsitem.headline: GREEK ECONMIN TO SPEAK ON ECONOMY IN NEW YORK.

text.p: National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou will speak on the challenges and opportunities offered by the Greek economy at a luncheon organised by the Harvard Business School Club of Greater New York on Friday.

The luncheon is sponsored by the state Commercial Bank of Greece and will take place at 1200 EST (1700 GMT) at The Plaza Hotel in New York City, said Capital Link, the North American investor relations representative of Commercial Bank. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
